licensing_notes: Python official docs identify PSF License Version 2 and additional Zero-Clause BSD for examples.
PostgreSQL 18 documentation identifies itself as 18.7 documentation and is covered by PostgreSQL License.
PyTorch documentation source repository pytorch/docs states BSD licensing; this differs from the PyTorch software source repository licence.
Chroma's software Apache-2.0 licence does not establish documentation-content licensing. T11-T13 remain pending.
Docling repository is MIT-licensed; retain notices and review third-party materials.
MCP specification repository is MIT; separate MCP documentation repository states CC BY 4.0 for documentation excluding specifications.
GitHub Docs style guide states GitHub Docs licensed content is CC-BY; preserve attribution and licence link.
